correct_completion: I would finish reading the whole novel.
full_sentence: If I had more time, I would finish reading the whole novel.
acceptable_variants: I could finish the whole novel.
I would probably read the entire book.

options.text: I finish reading the whole novel.
options.why_wrong: The present simple 'finish' does not express the unreal condition set by 'had'; the main clause needs 'would' plus the base form.

options.text: I will finish reading the whole novel.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' expresses a real future plan, not the hypothetical result of an unreal condition.

options.text: I finished reading the whole novel yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This describes a completed past event unrelated to the condition, so it does not complete the hypothetical result.

options.text: I would finish reading the whole novel.

grammar_focus: Second conditional: 'If + past simple, would + base form' for unreal present situations
explanation: The clause with 'had' describes an unreal present situation, so the main clause uses 'would' with the base form of the verb. Learners often use a real future form here because the first conditional is more common in their first language patterns.
translation: Gdybym miał więcej czasu, przeczytałbym całą powieść.
